reviewNotes: First 68 weapon records translated directly and reviewed as 34 name/description pairs. Weapon-class terms follow the reviewed glossary: Sabie, Pumnal and Măciucă. Galaxy and scythe names use locked terminology. Descriptions preserve material, provenance, sharpness, weight, magic and joke details. Infinity forms explicitly remain the true forms of their corresponding Galaxy weapons; Iridium Scythe retains both all-crop harvesting and hay gathering.

AbbysPlanchette_Description.translation: Este făcută din lemn marmorat de calitate.

AlexsBat_Description.source: The sweet spot is dented from Alex's famous Grand Slam.
AlexsBat_Description.translation: Zona de lovire este îndoită de celebrul grand slam al lui Alex.

Femur_Name.preservationReason: Femur is the standard Romanian anatomical noun.
